children: EFG Holding has secured a $40 million, four-year term loan from the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) to support financing for micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in Egypt.
The transaction marks the first financing facility extended directly to EFG Holding at the holding-company level and the company's first direct funding partnership with the EBRD.
(Writing by Ahmad Mousa; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: EFG Holding secures $40mln EBRD loan to expand MSME financing
